notes.title: Return of the Slurp
notes.content:
[h2]Popper Play[/h2]
The newest set of maps are all themed around our most downloaded game - Virus Popper. Battle the alien viruses, unlock the nasty but awesome space virus themed skin, and conquer the terrifying Virus Boss as a team in the final map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/afc317e8c545b2047529a90dc670db650ded55a2.png[/img]

[h2]Beware Your Surroundings[/h2]
We are introducing a new game mechanic - deadly obstacles and environments! On all of the new Popper maps, you have to play around moving obstacles and environments, offering a unique and challenging twist on traditional Space Slurpies gameplay.
[list]
[*] Leaky Lab - avoid bubbling lava!
[*] Castle Conquest - dodge the mighty swinging Vaxcalibur!
[*] Crystal Cavern - sidestep piercing crystals!
[*] And more!! Play every map to experience this new game mode!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/42b026276721560f38f5dda648cf09732f31cc2f.png[/img]

[h2]Looking Goooooodd[/h2]
We spent extra time polishing all maps. In addition to the new maps, we went back and remastered many of the new maps for the next generation of headsets. Check out the stunning new details in Buoyant Blossoms and replay some of your old favorites to see how we made a great game even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/9fadcdb9398764a792fc0cef04be3b1ae05d016f.png[/img]

[h2]Feeling Gooooodd[/h2]
Wow! Even with the the new content, maps, and skins, the game is now HALF the size in your storage! Why?? We spent a lot of time optimizing the performance of the game, increasing framerate, decreasing memory, and making this the best performing version of Space Slurpies to ever be released! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/c59f1470418b21e3b8dc5fc14eff20a12751e2a7.png[/img]

[h2]Hello World :)[/h2]
Get ready to welcome a lot of new players to the world of Space Slurpies! In two weeks, we are releasing a FREE version of Space Slurpies to get more people in the game. In order to make online play even more interesting with the new players coming soon, we're mixing up Matchmaking - expect lots of randomized modifiers for a hilarious good time! Just to be clear, the paid version is [i]still[/i] the premium Slurpie experience. You have access to all map packs (Zen, Popper Play), associated skins (Ninja, Virus Slurp), and [i]more[/i]. Also, to specially thank you for supporting our studio, every paid version of the game gets access to the unique and bubbly Orbit skin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/f9c24e81a8e3a23f38cc0e703090560d1d607fdf.png[/img]

[b]Other notable items to prove that we have been working hard[/b]
We added a lot more bug fixes and polishes. Many of which I've forgotten by now, but here are a few more favorites to point out, making this an awesome patch (that we worked really hard on!).
[list]
[*] Leaderboard fixes (especially for Oculus headsets)
[*] All achievements fixed and verified to be working properly
[*] DLC enablement for App Lab users (with cross-play to Steam)
[*] Cross-platform multiplayer for FREE and PAID users across ALL headsets
[*] Pro Controls mode disables slurping assistance
[*] LOD improvements - no more clipping or discoloration of edibles in the distance
[*] Mesh optimization - Slurps look even better from a distance
[*] Shader improvements - increased framerates and load times
[*] All types of sounds can now be muted from settings menu
[*] Fixed bug where matchmaking voice chat and private game voice chat drops after the first round
[*] Removed microphone access request from start of game and moved into multiplayer only when needed
[*] Bug fix that keeps the menu screen from flashing up before a round starts
[*] Next game will start automatically after a time period, keeping gameplay moving
[*] Multiplayer performance and networking improvements
[*] Map thumbnail bug fixed in map selection menu for private matches
[/list]

P.S. If you made it this far, did you know that Space Slurpies only has one dev? Yeah, for real. So if you like this game, please tell your friends so that you can support a solo dev and save him from starvation. He's not making much money right now and is eating an unhealthy amount of ramen. Also, he has to be a wedding DJ to pay his bills. Fun job, yes, but he'd rather spend his time and energy making more content for you all!

notes.title: Our Slurpies Slurp Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/fe8579c8a495856341b8f2ea92d193581bfe4e5a.png[/img]

[b]Our worms suck![/b] No really, they actually can slurp up food now like a vacuum. Feel like we should have thought of this sooner... but hey, at least we included it now! It's a lot of fun, so I definitely encourage you to try it out!

[b]Dead snakes give bonuses to remaining players.[/b] It's a completely original idea that we thought of ourselves. It has never been done in another snake related game ever. Ever. 

Also:
[list]
[*] [b]UI updates[/b] - see your combos and points next to your slurpie worm to get the highest score possible! 
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] - model updates on Buoyant Blossom, region selector optimization for playing with friends.
[/list]

[url=https://youtube.com/shorts/EXxVDbHfnuo?feature=share][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/a7b9a77ce6b93c09febc23318020831650ca6cbb.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Zen Patch Update
notes.content:
You asked and we listened! We could not be more excited to deliver the all new Zen Patch to Space Slurpies.

[previewyoutube=yrrPQsYKfE0;full][/previewyoutube]

This patch attempts to deliver everything that fans of Space Slurpies has been asking for. This patch is so big that no amount of scribbled notes could cover it all, but here are some of the highlights:
[list]
[*] [b]Zen Mode[/b] - The all new Zen Mode is a unique way to enjoy slurpin' action. Instead of fighting against enemies, you're trying to beat the clock while relaxing in the many vibrant environments by collecting rings. Chill out dude, it's Zen Mode!
[*] [b]9 New Maps[/b] - With the Zen Patch comes 8 new Zen-themed maps. Inspired by the most relaxing environments in nature, we take up the chill factor in Slurpies 10 levels. There's a map inspired by each of the four seasons and all are filled with the newest baddie - the Zen Rock. 
[*] [b]Modifiers[/b] - With the new modifiers, you can customize any game with hundreds of combinations. We're introducing Double Slurp Mode (yes, a Slurpie in each hand!), Big Head Mode, Slug Mode (they get fatter as they eat instead of just longer lol), Never Die Mode (perfect for chilling with your friends online), and more! 
[*] [b]Boss Mode[/b] - Space Slurpies first boss shows up in the universe! On Raging Robots, users battle a giant robot by trying to combine their scores and blow it up. Find three friends and see if you can beat him!
[*] [b]Ninja Slurp[/b] - Only the truly zen can unlock and play as the all new Ninja Slurp skin. Best of luck great warrior!
[*] [b]Region Selector[/b] - Play with friends anywhere in the world with the new region selector for private matches.
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] - Yeah, we fixed everything we knew about. If I wrote them all down, would you really read them? I doubt it. I'm going back to coding now...
[/list]

notes.title: Combo Meter, Live Leaderboards, and Money Bags!
notes.content:
[b]Leaderboards are Live![/b]
All of the leaderboards, for both solo and matchmaking have been fixed up and are now live. Good luck staying on top and keep Slurpin'!

[b]ComboBot for Score Enthusiasts [/b]
Some people were asking us questions about the scorekeeping, points per edible, and combos. We made all of that easier by adding a ComboBot that can keep track of this for you. Get the highest score possible with this nifty fellow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38848187/0228d0879060719b35d31a7f88ad11442d6ceaa6.gif[/img]

[b]Mr. Money Bags Slurp[/b]
What's the most ridiculous DLC we could launch right at the start of the Slurp era - Mr. Money Bags... an overly expensive gold snake with a top hat and bow tie. You must [i]really[/i] have spare change if you want to flex this hard on other players. Or just want to support this awesome, but broke two-man studio. Thanks! We love you <3

[previewyoutube=uFVPXabHGdE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Networking Improvements [/b]
We also included a number of networking fixes for a better multiplayer experience.
[list]
[*] Expanded cross platform support - even play users on Quest!
[*] Scene syncing issues for cross platform play
[*] Faster connection and syncing of matchmaking lounges
[/list]

Keep us updated on any bugs you find and we'll jump on them! 
Discord is a great place to get instant responses:
[url=https://discord.gg/eFqWcT5]Starcade Arcade Discord[/url]
